outcome: Factors associated with AR in comorbidity with asthma (CARAS)
cohort: 416 adults aged 18-68 years undergoing immunotherapy at two allergy referral centers in Bogotá, Colombia
finding: Regular acetaminophen use was associated with allergic rhinitis, while cesarean delivery was associated with allergic rhinitis and comorbid asthma.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with allergic rhinitis and comorbid asthma.
